answer: Pre-dermal condensate (pre-Dc) cells migrate towards the epidermis. During this migration, genes involved in regulation of cell adhesion (ADAMST1), cell-cell contacts (CLDN11), and directed migration (CXCL12) are upregulated. As pre-Dc cells aggregate into the dermal condensate (Dc), genes implicated in collagen fibril formation and cell adhesion (COL6A3, MFAP4, PTK7) are expressed.
